div.head: II Em 1.3
div.ab: Gif þonne of ðære oðre mægðe hwa wrace dó on ænigum oðrum men butan on ðam rihthanddædan, sy he gefah wið þone cyning ⁊ wið ealle his frind ⁊ ðolige ealles ðæs he age.
Gyf ðonne of ðære mægðe hwa wrace do on ænigum oðrum men butan on ðam rihthanddædan, sy he gefah wið ðone cyning ⁊ wið ealle his frynd ⁊ ðolie ealles ðæs he age.
Si ex mortui cognatione quis uindictam perpetret in alium aliquem preter ipsum malefactorem, sit inimicus regis et omnium amicorum eius et perdat totum quicquid habet.
Gyf ðonne of ðære [oðre] mægðe hwa wrace do on ænigum oðrum men butan on ðam rihthanddædan, sy he gefah wið ðone cyning ⁊ wið ealle his frynd ⁊ ðolie ealles ðæs he age.

If, however, anyone from the other kindred take vengeance on any man other than the actual delinquent, he shall incur the hostility of the king and all of his his friends, and shall suffer the loss of all that he possesses.

Wenn jedoch einer von der anderen Sippe [des Erschlagenen] Rache übt an irgend einem anderen Menschen als an dem richtigen Thäter, so sei er friedlos gegenüber dem König und allen dessen Freunden und verliere [an diesen] alles, was er besitzt.

If, however, anyone of the other kindred [that of the slain man] takes vengeance on any other person than the actual perpetrator, let him be at feud with the king and all his friends and lose [to them] everything he owns.
